{{Quote|You were hired to protect me! Your job was to help me escape from this overbuilt rock! Is this what you call escape?|Varesk Bura'lya to Jax Pavan|<ref name="sos" />}}
'''Varesk Bura'lya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] undersecretary who worked for the Bothan embassy on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Shortly after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], he feared for his life and contacted the resistance movement [[Whiplash]] seeking help for safe passage offworld.<ref name="sos" />

Bura'lya was escorted by former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]] and his crew which consisted of [[I-5YQ|I-Five]], [[Den Dhur]] and [[Laranth Tarak]]. During his extraction, their group was ambushed by a squad of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in their final checkpoint. A brief shootout ensued where everyone from their group emerged relatively unharmed, with exception to Bura'lya who fainted and lost control of his bladder.<ref name="sos" />

They eventually made it to the rendezvous point and he boarded the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Big Score]]''.<ref name="sos" />
